protocol_metadata.about: Lagoon is an ERC-7540 compliant on-chain vault infrastructure protocol for institutional asset managers, protocols, and funds to deploy and scale tokenized investment strategies across DeFi, RWAs, and off-chain mandates. Features include independent NAV computation, role-based access control (vault admin, curator, valuation manager, investor), Safe/MPC custody integration, fee management, and transparent audit-ready reporting. Non-custodial and audited across 120+ vaults on 18+ chains.
